title: Trump arrives in Manila for state visit, ASEAN-US Special Summit
summary: US President Donald Trump will also meet with fellow Quad leaders in Manila where protests against Pax Silica and the US war on Iran await him

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – US President Donald Trump arrived in Manila late Tuesday afternoon, November 17, for a state visit and to participate in the ASEAN-US Special Summit and the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (Quad) leaders’ summit on the sidelines of the ASEAN Summit.

Trump arrived in Manila amid protests from groups opposed to his policies, especially the US war on Iran and his administration’s vaunted Pax Silica initiative. Hundreds had been arrested in relation to the protests that began on November 15, the opening of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits.

Before Trump’s late afternoon arrival on Tuesday, ASEAN leaders held meetings with Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung, Chinese Premier Li Qiang, and Indian President Narendra Modi, ahead of the annual East Asia Summit.
Trump skipped the East Asia Summit but will join a US-ASEAN Special Summit as well as the Quad leaders’ summit, both scheduled after the conclusion of the ASEAN Summit.

The meeting of the Quad — the US, Japan, Australia, and India — will be Trump’s first and takes place two years after the last gathering of the group, which his predecessor Joe Biden regarded as a signature foreign policy initiative.

It comes just ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders’ Meeting hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping who previously objected to the Quad as an effort to encircle Beijing. Quad members have said the grouping is not directed against any one country.

On Wednesday, November 18, Trump will have bilateral meeting with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in Malacañang, to be followed by a state luncheon in his honor before he departs for the APEC Summit in Shenzen.

Trump’s Asia trip, which also includes a much-anticipated trilateral meeting with his Chinese and Russian counterparts in Shenzen, comes after his Republican Party’s defeat in midterm elections and spy allegations that could complicate a fragile trade-war truce between the US and China. – With reports from Reuters/Rappler.com
